title: ר' שמעון בן ננס

paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Nannas: Mishnah Bikkurim 3:9; Shabbat 16:5, 120a; Eruvin 10:15, 104b, “R' Shimon ben Nannas says; R' Akiva says”; Ketubbot 10:5; Gittin 8:10; Bava Batra 7:3, 10:8; Shevuot 7:5, and at the beginning of Kol ha-Nishba'in, 45a, Ben Nannas; Menahot 4:3, 45b. His colleague R' Yishmael said of him, “Whoever wishes to engage in monetary law should study under Ben Nannas”: Mishnah, end of Bava Batra, 175b. He was a colleague of Ben Azzai, Ben Zoma, and R' Akiva, and one of the five who argued before the sages; see Danin. R' Yehudah ben Bava was in his time. R' Yose of Dormaskit.
